Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCDifficulty_tool: How much damage survivors deal to you, how well they shoot and how far they see you.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCVsPlayerDamage_: Multiplies the wounds hostile survivors cause you (cuts, scratches and bullets). Never infects. Clothing protects.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCHealth_tooltip: Base health. Scaled by archetype (brawler x1.0, shooter x0.85, medic and sneak x0.75) and protective clothing (x1.25). A regular zombie has about 1.0 to 2.0.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCDamageMultiplie: Multiplies survivors' weapon damage against zombies and other survivors.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_FleeHealthPercent_: Health percentage below which a survivor flees the fight. 0 = never flees.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_RaiderMugging_tool: When they find you, raiders demand your bag and weapon. Complying or leaving avoids the fight.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_FriendlyFire_toolt: Only applies to your followers. Other survivors can always be hurt, and that lowers your reputation with their group.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_Barks_tooltip: Short lines: greetings, warnings, threats, calls for help, reactions to zombies.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_MaxActive_tooltip: How many survivors can be physically near you at once. The rest keep living off-screen. Fewer = lighter.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_CollapsePace_toolt: How fast the world goes from the civilian chaos of the first days to scarcity with raiders. Also counts the game's 'Months since the Apocalypse'.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_RaiderStartDay_too: Before this day of the apocalypse there are no organized raider groups. After it, they grow gradually. In the first 3 days nothing hostile appears near where you started.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_WorldGroups_toolti: Total limit of groups (families, militias, raiders, cults, drifters). They appear per region as you explore: more in towns, almost none in the countryside.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_GroupDensity_toolt: How many groups each town or neighborhood gets. 100 = 1 group per 40 buildings.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_RaiderPercent_tool: Share of new groups that are raiders, once raiders exist (see 'Day raiders begin').
Sandbox_Remanescentes_AmbientDensity_too: Passers-by: civilians walking, fleeing, calling for help, fighting, boarding up. 0 disables. Drops over the days and is lower in the countryside.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_FortifyHomes_toolt: Group houses get inside barricades, a locked main door, a supply stash, zombie corpses outside, a sign, a campfire and lights at night.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_BaseFallRate_toolt: Daily chance of a base being overrun by zombies. Small, poorly fortified groups fall more often. 0 disables.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_ScavengeDeathChanc: Death chance on a supply run
Chance (percent) of an off-screen supply run costing the group a member.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_LootLeftPercent_to: Chance (percent) of each container in a building already raided by a group still having items.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_ZombieAttackMode_t: Real: zombies use their own attack AI against survivors. Simulated: scripted lunge animation and damage (use if Real misbehaves).
Sandbox_Remanescentes_ZombieDamage_toolt: Health a survivor loses per landed zombie attack.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_ZombieSightRange_t: Distance (tiles) at which a zombie notices a survivor by day. Halved at night, lower if crouched, higher if running.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCNoiseMultiplier: Scales the noise they make fighting, running and shooting (attracts zombies). 0 = silent.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCsTurn_tooltip: Bitten survivors get infected and turn hours later; those killed by zombies rise again. Same clothes.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCInfectionChance: Percentage of each zombie hit on a survivor that infects them.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_DebugMenu_tooltip: Shows the 'Testing tools' submenu (spawn survivors, groups, events, teleport, simulate time). Off for normal play.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_Verbose_tooltip: Writes what survivors and groups do to console.txt (useful when reporting problems).
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCBaseWork_toolti: How much NPC groups work on their own bases: planks, fences, barbed wire, cars in the streets. 0 turns it off; 100 is the same pace as your base.
